def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    orders = db["orders"]
    items = db["order_items"]
    reviews = db["reviews"]
    payments = db["payments"]

    seed_time = pd.Timestamp(seed_time)
    product_ids = list(entity_ids)

    EMPTY_COLS = [
        "num_items_total", "num_orders_total", "total_price", "avg_price",
        "std_price", "total_freight", "avg_freight", "avg_review_score",
        "num_reviews", "avg_total_paid", "avg_installments",
        "avg_credit_card_share", "recency_days", "avg_days_ago",
        "items_7d", "items_30d", "items_60d", "items_90d",
        "score_last3", "sales_accel",
        "paid_last90", "has_delivery", "avg_delivery_delay",
    ]

    def empty_features():
        feats = pd.DataFrame(0.0, index=product_ids, columns=EMPTY_COLS)
        feats["recency_days"] = 9999.0
        feats["avg_days_ago"] = 9999.0
        return feats

    # Только заказы, уже существовавшие на момент seed_time
    orders_before = orders[orders["order_purchase_timestamp"] < seed_time]
    if orders_before.empty:
        return empty_features()

    order_time = orders_before[["order_id", "order_purchase_timestamp"]].rename(
        columns={"order_purchase_timestamp": "purchase_time"}
    )

    hist = items[["order_id", "product_id", "price", "freight_value"]].merge(
        order_time, on="order_id", how="inner"
    )
    hist = hist[hist["product_id"].isin(product_ids)]
    if hist.empty:
        return empty_features()

    hist["days_ago"] = (seed_time - hist["purchase_time"]).dt.days
    for window in [7, 30, 60, 90]:
        hist[f"in_{window}d"] = (hist["days_ago"] <= window).astype(int)

    # Отзывы: только те, что созданы до seed_time
    if not reviews.empty:
        rev = reviews[reviews["review_creation_date"] < seed_time]
        if not rev.empty:
            order_rev = rev.groupby("order_id")["review_score"].agg(
                ["mean", "count"]).reset_index()
            order_rev.columns = ["order_id", "order_avg_score", "order_num_reviews"]
            hist = hist.merge(order_rev, on="order_id", how="left")
        else:
            hist["order_avg_score"] = np.nan
            hist["order_num_reviews"] = 0.0
    else:
        hist["order_avg_score"] = np.nan
        hist["order_num_reviews"] = 0.0

    # Платежи: только записи, существовавшие до seed_time
    if not payments.empty and "ts" in payments.columns:
        pay = payments[payments["ts"] < seed_time]
    else:
        pay = payments
    if not pay.empty:
        pay = pay[["order_id", "payment_type", "payment_installments", "payment_value"]].copy()
        pay["is_credit"] = (pay["payment_type"] == "credit_card").astype(int)
        order_pay = pay.groupby("order_id").agg(
            order_total_paid=("payment_value", "sum"),
            order_avg_installments=("payment_installments", "mean"),
            order_credit_share=("is_credit", "mean"),
        ).reset_index()
        hist = hist.merge(order_pay, on="order_id", how="left")
    else:
        for col in ["order_total_paid", "order_avg_installments", "order_credit_share"]:
            hist[col] = np.nan

    # Доставка: только если она уже произошла до seed_time
    deliv = orders_before[["order_id", "order_purchase_timestamp",
                           "order_delivered_customer_date"]].copy()
    deliv = deliv[deliv["order_delivered_customer_date"].notna()
                  & (deliv["order_delivered_customer_date"] < seed_time)]
    if not deliv.empty:
        deliv["delivery_delay"] = (
            deliv["order_delivered_customer_date"] - deliv["order_purchase_timestamp"]
        ).dt.days
        hist = hist.merge(deliv[["order_id", "delivery_delay"]],
                          on="order_id", how="left")
    else:
        hist["delivery_delay"] = np.nan

    grouped = hist.groupby("product_id")

    g90 = hist[hist["in_90d"] == 1].groupby("product_id")["price"]
    items_last30 = hist[hist["days_ago"] <= 30].groupby("product_id")["price"].count()
    items_prev30 = hist[(hist["days_ago"] > 30) & (hist["days_ago"] <= 60)].groupby(
        "product_id")["price"].count()

    features = pd.DataFrame({
        "num_items_total": grouped["price"].count(),
        "num_orders_total": grouped["order_id"].nunique(),
        "total_price": grouped["price"].sum(),
        "avg_price": grouped["price"].mean(),
        "std_price": grouped["price"].std().fillna(0.0),
        "total_freight": grouped["freight_value"].sum(),
        "avg_freight": grouped["freight_value"].mean(),
        "avg_review_score": grouped["order_avg_score"].mean().fillna(0.0),
        "num_reviews": grouped["order_num_reviews"].sum().fillna(0.0),
        "avg_total_paid": grouped["order_total_paid"].mean().fillna(0.0),
        "avg_installments": grouped["order_avg_installments"].mean().fillna(0.0),
        "avg_credit_card_share": grouped["order_credit_share"].mean().fillna(0.0),
        "recency_days": grouped["days_ago"].min(),
        "avg_days_ago": grouped["days_ago"].mean(),
        "items_7d": grouped["in_7d"].sum(),
        "items_30d": grouped["in_30d"].sum(),
        "items_60d": grouped["in_60d"].sum(),
        "items_90d": grouped["in_90d"].sum(),
        "score_last3": g90.mean().fillna(0.0),
        "sales_accel": (items_last30 - items_prev30).fillna(0.0),
        "paid_last90": hist[hist["in_90d"] == 1].groupby(
            "product_id")["order_total_paid"].sum().fillna(0.0),
        "has_delivery": grouped["delivery_delay"].apply(lambda s: s.notna().any()).astype(float),
        "avg_delivery_delay": grouped["delivery_delay"].mean().fillna(0.0),
    })

    features = features.reindex(product_ids)
    for col in ["recency_days", "avg_days_ago"]:
        features[col] = features[col].fillna(9999.0)
    for col in features.columns:
        if col not in ["recency_days", "avg_days_ago"]:
            features[col] = features[col].fillna(0.0)

    return features.reindex(product_ids).fillna(0.0)
